description: Aggregate federal spending grouped by a specific dimension: NAICS industry code, PSC product/service code, awarding agency, funding agency, CFDA assistance program, or recipient. Returns top items with obligation amounts — useful for trend and breakdown analysis. Filter by keyword, award type, agency, recipient, NAICS code, Assistance Listing, PSC, DEF code, or date range. Chain NAICS, PSC, and CFDA codes back into these filters, into usaspending_search_awards filters, or into usaspending_autocomplete_filters lookups. recipient_duns rows carry recipient_id, which opens the recipient profile in usaspending_get_recipient, and uei.

category.description: Breakdown dimension: naics (industry), psc (product/service code), awarding_agency, awarding_subagency, funding_agency, funding_subagency, cfda (assistance programs), or recipient_duns (recipients)

filters.description: Optional filters to scope the aggregation

agency_name.description: Awarding agency name filter, top-tier only (e.g., "Department of Defense") — the toptier_name from usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=awarding_agency; a sub-agency name matches nothing

assistance_listings.description: Filter by Assistance Listing (CFDA) program numbers, e.g. ["15.507"]: two digits, a dot, then three digits or capital letters (11.67A). Matches an award when any of its listings equals one of these exactly; several values match any of them. A matching award's primary listing can differ from the one requested, and amounts cover the whole award, not that listing's share. Only assistance awards (grants, direct payments, loans, other assistance) carry listings, so a call whose award types are all contracts or IDVs — including a contract default — is rejected as assistance_listings_type_mismatch. Use usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=cfda to look up numbers.

def_codes.description: Filter by Disaster Emergency Fund Codes (DEF), e.g. ["Z"], or ["L", "M", "N", "O", "P"] for COVID-19: 1–3 letters or digits, sent uppercased — the codes usaspending_disaster_spending takes and usaspending_get_agency lists. Matches awards of any type funded under any of these codes. Amounts cover the whole matching award, not the share funded by the code, and DEF-filtered totals can be negative. An unknown code is rejected with the list of codes USAspending accepts.

items.description: Disaster Emergency Fund Code, e.g. Z or L

psc_codes.description: Filter by Product and Service Codes (PSC), e.g. ["Y1NE"]: 1–4 letters or digits, sent uppercased. A shorter code covers every code under it ("Y1" covers "Y1NE"); several values match any of them. Only contracts and IDVs carry a PSC, so a call whose award types are all assistance types is rejected as psc_codes_type_mismatch, and pairing psc_codes with assistance_listings matches nothing, since no award carries both. Use usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=psc to look up codes.

items.description: Product and Service Code or prefix, e.g. Y1NE or Y1

anyOf.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; month and day may be unpadded

time_period_end.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). Given alone, the window starts at 2007-10-01, the earliest searchable date.

anyOf.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; month and day may be unpadded

time_period_start.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD), 2007-10-01 or later. Given alone, the window runs through today (UTC).

name: usaspending_spending_by_category

applied_time_period_end.description: End date sent (YYYY-MM-DD), including a filled-in end

applied_time_period_start.description: Start date sent (YYYY-MM-DD), including a filled-in start

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_unavailable`: USAspending.gov API is unreachable or returns an error. `api_timeout`: USAspending.gov did not respond before the request deadline elapsed. `date_range_inverted`: Both filters.time_period_start and filters.time_period_end were supplied and the start falls after the end. `date_before_earliest`: The resolved start date precedes the 2007-10-01 earliest date this endpoint can search. `assistance_listings_type_mismatch`: filters.assistance_listings was given while every code in filters.award_type_codes is a contract or IDV code. `psc_codes_type_mismatch`: filters.psc_codes was given while every code in filters.award_type_codes is an assistance code. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Names a date bound that was filled in because only the other was supplied, and — when results are empty — names any Assistance Listing, PSC, or DEF codes sent and suggests how to broaden filters. Absent when neither applies.

results.description: Top items in this category by obligation amount

items.description: Category item with code, name, and obligation amount

code.description: Code value (NAICS, PSC, CFDA number, recipient DUNS, etc.)

recipient_id.description: Recipient hash ID (recipient_duns rows) — pass to usaspending_get_recipient for the profile. Absent when upstream has none.

uei.description: Recipient Unique Entity Identifier (recipient_duns rows). Absent when upstream has none.

totalCount.description: Total number of items in this category (when available)

title: Spending by Category
